summary: Step 3 (AI intent understanding) full backend + frontend E2E testing on the public preview URL. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_ai_intent.py (12 cases, real Anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6 calls via emergentintegrations, ~2.8s per POST /api/issues): auto-analysis on POST /api/issues populates primary_intent/desired_outcome/category/priority/urgency/sentiment/entities/human_judgment_required/human_reason/ai_analyzed/lane with no _id leak; interaction detected_intent + detected_sentiment backfilled; staff GET /api/issues/{id} returns all AI fields; 5 seeded issues all ai_analyzed=true with full fields; auth still enforced (401 unauth). CHECKPOINT 3 independently CONFIRMED with 3 DISTINCT intents: (1) 'Can my friend park overnight?' -> wants permission / parking / P3 / normal / neutral / hjr=false / lane RESOLVE; (2) 'Someone keeps parking in my assigned space.' -> wants action taken / parking / P1 / urgent / frustrated / hjr=true / lane REVIEW (priority higher than #1); (3) 'I've complained three times...' -> wants to escalate a prior issue / P1 / angry / hjr=true with reason citing 'reported the same issue three times without resolution' / lane REVIEW. Also verified resident reply re-analysis with prior context escalates correctly, and an emergency message ('water pouring from ceiling + smoke from outlet') -> P0 / emergency / safety / hjr=true. Regression: backend_test.py + test_documents.py 48/48 passed (2 stale pre-AI assertions updated by me). Frontend: staff detail Sheet AI Understanding section renders real values for seeded and newly-created issues (ai-intent, ai-category, ai-outcome, ai-priority, ai-sentiment, ai-entities chips, ai-human-judgment amber block with reason); resident submit runs AI live (POST 200, intent 'wants to escalate a prior issue'); My Requests lookup works; staff status + assigned team PATCH persist; Property Knowledge shows 4 Ready demo docs. All TEST_ data cleaned up: 5 seeded issues + 50 residents intact.

minor.issue: The resident-supplied `category` is silently overwritten by the AI taxonomy (submitting category='HVAC' returns category='other'). The resident portal still shows a Category select whose value is discarded - either drop the field, or keep it as `resident_category` alongside the AI category.

Re-analysis unconditionally $sets priority and lane, so a resident reply can overwrite staff manual triage (e.g. staff-set P0/ACTION reverts to the AI value). Consider not overriding fields a human has explicitly changed, or record ai_priority separately.
AI call is awaited inline, adding ~2.8-3.7s to every resident submit. Consider BackgroundTasks + polling/optimistic UI so the resident isn't blocked.
ai_location is never populated when the message does not name a unit (unit_location='' -> field left null) even though issue.unit is known; consider falling back to issue.unit.
On AI failure only ai_analyzed=false is written - priority/lane keep model defaults and there is no retry/re-analyze endpoint for staff.

issues: Sheet title renders the raw AI category in lowercase ('maintenance') as the heading; capitalize it like the AI Understanding fields.
Radix console warning persists: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on the detail Sheet.
Submit button gives no AI-specific progress hint during the ~3s AI call; only a generic pending state.

action_items: Decide the resident-selected category behavior (currently discarded by AI overwrite) - remove the select or preserve it separately.
Prevent AI re-analysis on resident reply from clobbering staff-set priority/lane.
Capitalize the category heading in IssueDetailSheet and add a SheetDescription/aria-describedby to clear the Radix warning.
Optional: move AI analysis to a background task + add a staff 're-analyze' action for ai_analyzed=false issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is at 800 lines - split AI analysis (AI_SYSTEM_MESSAGE, analyze_message, derive_lane, apply_analysis) into /app/backend/ai.py and documents routes into their own router.

apply_analysis() does not validate urgency/sentiment/category against the allowed enums (only priority is validated), so a model drift could persist an out-of-taxonomy value that the frontend badges may not map.
derive_lane() maps human_judgment_required -> REVIEW before intent, so every escalation lands in REVIEW and never ACTION; confirm this is the intended precedence.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_-prefixed residents/issues created during the AI + UI runs; all deleted afterwards. DB verified back at 5 issues / 50 residents / 4 property_documents.
test_credentials: Session injection only (Google OAuth app). user_id 'test-user-step2', session_token 'test_session_step2_demo' in test_database (users/user_sessions) - still present, not logged out.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run AI tests with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_ai_intent.py -v -p no:randomly -s -n 0` — the module-scoped checkpoint fixture and cleanup do NOT work under pytest-xdist parallel workers (each worker re-creates issues), so -n 0 is required. Seeded-issue assertions filter by resident_name not starting with 'TEST_'. Documents live in the `property_documents` collection (not `documents`). AI latency ~2.8-3.7s per POST /api/issues; always wait on the response, never a fixed timeout. Playwright: add_cookies session_token on domain triage-skeleton.preview.emergentagent.com (httpOnly, secure, sameSite None); resident portal testids are resident-name-input / resident-unit-input / resident-message-input / submit-issue-btn / tab-track-request / track-requests-btn (NOT submit-request-btn). Do not click sign-out.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects blocking CHECKPOINT 3. The two initial regression failures in backend_test.py were stale pre-Step-3 assertions (lane=='REVIEW', priority=='P2', category is None / category=='HVAC') that AI analysis now legitimately overwrites; I updated the assertions to accept AI-populated values. The category overwrite is a real product decision to confirm, since the resident-chosen category is discarded.
